pilot.name_zh: AI 原点普通服务节点
pilot.public_promise_zh: 普通入口、人工接管、纸面回执和退出路径先于可撤回 AI 服务岛。
pilot.public_promise_en: Ordinary entry, human takeover, paper receipt and exit come before a removable AI service island.

dimension_rule.source: ALT-C concept translated into a parametric node dossier
dimension_rule.forbidden_upgrade: No target dimension is a surveyed, statutory, engineering, tender or as-built dimension.

plan_1_500.orientation: ordinary route along the south edge; maintenance access from the north edge

modules.name_zh: 低刺激等候与语音入口
可撤回 AI 服务岛

plan_1_500.flow_rule: ordinary route never enters the removable island footprint and remains open in BASE, BLACKOUT and CLOSEOUT
plan_1_500.capacity_formula: release_capacity = min(fire_review, accessible_route_review, staffed_service_review, verified_waiting_area / approved_person_area)

section_1_100.blackout_rule: isolate power and data at the island, preserve staffed and paper service, keep the 3.0 m ordinary band unobstructed

detail_1_50.closeout_rule: remove island hardware, cap utilities, restore the floor and retain the ordinary route, desk, paper record and complaint contact

delivery_contract.pilot_window: 18 weeks after all G0 authorisation and baseline gates pass; not a promised calendar

schedule.work_zh: 授权、权属和公众问题确认
schedule.release_gate: named accountable owner and ordinary-service baseline

schedule.work_zh: 测绘、无障碍、消防和市政联审
schedule.work_en: survey, accessibility, fire and utilities review

schedule.work_zh: 竞争性采购与样机深化
schedule.release_gate: cost, insurance, data and rollback clauses

schedule.work_zh: 离线预制、普通路径先行施工
schedule.release_gate: route and staffed service accepted before AI installation

schedule.work_zh: 停用、接管、维护和公众走查
schedule.work_en: blackout, takeover, maintenance and public walkthrough
schedule.release_gate: field evidence recorded; any critical failure returns to HOLD

schedule.work_zh: 独立复核与启用/返修/退役决定
schedule.work_en: independent review and open, revise or retire decision
schedule.release_gate: authorised decision record; no automatic release

procurement.method: two-stage, performance-based competitive pilot procurement after owner confirmation
sequence: publish ordinary-service baseline, rights, dimensions and unknowns
market sounding without preferred supplier or partnership claim
competitive concept and cost submission with open-book assumptions
prototype review including accessibility, data, safety, insurance and rollback
award only after accountable owner and funding authority are confirmed
pay against accepted ordinary-route, blackout, handover and closeout evidence
procurement.forbidden: No supplier, owner, operator, budget or award is confirmed by this submission.

capex_design_estimate_cny.price_basis: participant-authored 2026 concept allowance; excludes land, taxes, major utility relocation and statutory fees

line_items.name: ordinary route, wayfinding and accessible interfaces
removable AI and offline service hardware
data protection and independent audit allowance

service_level_targets.target: ordinary route and staffed or paper completion remain available throughout every public service window
a stop trigger isolates the AI island within 2 minutes without closing the ordinary route
a complaint receives acknowledgment within 1 working day and a status within 5 working days
opening and closeout checks are signed for route, desk, paper stock, power isolation and maintenance access
a critical accessibility, fire, privacy or consent failure reduces AI service capacity to zero immediately

delivery_contract.insurance_gate: public liability, professional liability, cyber/data and reinstatement responsibilities require written professional confirmation before procurement award
delivery_contract.acceptance_gate: release requires authorised owner, verified geometry, professional sign-offs, consented anonymised walkthrough evidence, cost confirmation and an independent decision record
delivery_contract.rollback: de-energise and remove the AI island, restore finishes, retain ordinary route and staffed/paper service, notify affected users, close complaints and archive the version record

required_but_missing: professional accessibility, fire and safety review
verified cost and named accountable organisations
field_acceptance.rule: Synthetic fixtures and local runner PASS never satisfy this field-acceptance gate.

boundary: Participant-authored design targets and low-confidence cost estimates only; not surveyed geometry, a tender price, a funded project, a partner appointment, field performance, professional approval, official score or release.
